+class EmbedSettingsCache:
+    def __init__(self, config: Config):
+        self._config: Config = config
+        self._cached_embed_settings: Dict[Tuple[str, int], Optional[bool]] = {}
+
+    async def get_embed_setting(self, command_name: str, guild_id: int) -> Optional[bool]:
+        """
+        Get the embed setting for a command in a guild from the cache
+        
+        Parameters
+        ----------
+        command_name: str
+            The qualified name of the command
+        guild_id: int
+            The ID of the guild, or 0 for global settings
+            
+        Returns
+        -------
+        Optional[bool]
+            The embed setting, or None if not set
+        """
+        key = (command_name, guild_id)
+        
+        if key in self._cached_embed_settings:
+            return self._cached_embed_settings[key]
+            
+        scope = self._config.custom("COMMAND", command_name, guild_id)
+        embed_setting = await scope.embeds()
+        self._cached_embed_settings[key] = embed_setting
+        return embed_setting
+        
+    async def set_embed_setting(self, command_name: str, guild_id: int, embed_setting: Optional[bool]) -> None:
+        """
+        Set the embed setting for a command in a guild and update the cache
+        
+        Parameters
+        ----------
+        command_name: str
+            The qualified name of the command
+        guild_id: int
+            The ID of the guild, or 0 for global settings
+        embed_setting: Optional[bool]
+            The embed setting to set, or None to clear
+        """
+        key = (command_name, guild_id)
+        
+        # Update the cache
+        self._cached_embed_settings[key] = embed_setting
+        
+        # Update the config
+        scope = self._config.custom("COMMAND", command_name, guild_id)
+        if embed_setting is None:
+            await scope.embeds.clear()
+        else:
+            await scope.embeds.set(embed_setting)
+

+        """
+        Invalidate a cache entry
+        
+        Parameters
+        ----------
+        command_name: str
+            The qualified name of the command
+        guild_id: int
+            The ID of the guild, or 0 for global settings
+        """
+        key = (command_name, guild_id)
+        self._cached_embed_settings.pop(key, None)
